## Teaching Philosophy

No matter how a student ends up in my classroom or office, I want to help them build the skills to think critically about data-driven evidence. I aim to:

-   **Teach adaptation alongside fundamentals**, by asking "what if" questions and practicing how to turn ambiguous, real-world questions into statistical ones.
-   **Lead with intuition**, by using simulations, visuals, and real-world examples before equations.
-   **Foster psychological safety**, so students feel comfortable asking questions and learning through trial and error.
-   **Encourage student buy-in**, by connecting statistical reasoning to students' goals and to everyday life.
